description: This source file defines an interface for handling callbacks related to row addition animations in a list view, allowing actions to be triggered at the start and end of the animation.

classes.name: OnRowAdditionAnimationListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to the start and end of row addition animations, primarily used to disable or re-enable UI elements during animation.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationStart
methods.description: Callback invoked when the row addition animation begins.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback invoked when the row addition animation ends.
